transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get started. We're here to review the retirement plan for the legacy analytics cluster. As we all know, the warehouse migration has passed the standard functional checks, and the current plan lists June 30 as the decommission date. Before I make a final approval decision, I need to check in with infrastructure and data governance as part of the normal review process. Who's here representing those areas?

transcript.text: I need to flag something before we finalize this plan. While checking migration logs this morning for an unrelated capacity issue, I found that the warehouse copy still needs a 48-hour read-only checksum run before the legacy cluster can be safely decommissioned. The run can start on June 30, but that means the cluster can't actually be decommissioned on June 30 itself — it would need to stay up until at least July 2. I haven't updated the retirement ticket with this yet.

transcript.text: I need to flag two governance requirements that I confirmed during a customer-records audit yesterday but haven't yet added to the retirement plan. First, an enterprise dashboard contract requires that a customer's analytics access must remain available through July 31 — so decommissioning on June 30 (or even July 2) would put us in breach of that contract. Second, regulated records from the cluster must be placed in an immutable snapshot retained for exactly 7 years before the cluster is retired. Neither requirement is currently reflected in the plan.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thank you both for flagging these issues — they're critical and need to be addressed before I can approve anything. Let me summarize what I'm hearing: Ravi, the 48-hour checksum run pushes the earliest safe decommission to July 2. Elena, you're telling me there's a contractual requirement keeping customer analytics access available through July 31, plus a regulatory requirement for a 7-year immutable snapshot of regulated records before retirement. Neither of these is in the current plan. Given all three constraints, June 30 is clearly off the table. The binding date appears to be July 31 at the earliest due to the enterprise dashboard contract, and the immutable snapshot needs to be created and verified before decommission. Ravi, can the checksum run be scheduled to align with a July 31 or August 1 decommission? And Elena, can you confirm the exact scope of records that need to go into the immutable snapshot so infrastructure can plan accordingly?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Thanks, Morgan. I'll update the retirement ticket with the checksum requirement and the revised timeline once we settle on the final date. I'll also need the scope of regulated records from Elena so we can plan both the checksum run and the immutable snapshot creation together.
